# Setting timeout in js

## Problem Statement

You need to complete the function logAfterDelay which takes an argument and console logs it value after a delay of 5 seconds.

 

### Input
NA

### Output
NA

### Example
NA

## Solution

```js
function logAfterDelay(message) {
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log(message);
  }, 5000);
}
```
